# Pulp OpenTofu

!!! warning "Beta, and not part of the Pulp Project"
    pulp_tofu is a beta Pulp plugin developed outside the Pulp Project. It is not in
    Pulp's container images or on [pulpproject.org](https://pulpproject.org/), and its
    API may change between releases without a deprecation period.

pulp_tofu lets OpenTofu users run `tofu init` against your Pulp instead of the public
registry, and lets you publish your own providers and modules to Pulp.

- [Read the documentation](site:pulp_tofu/)
- [Source and issues on GitHub](https://github.com/chad-loder/pulp_tofu)
- [Pulp Project documentation](https://pulpproject.org/), for pulpcore and its other
  plugins
